g.text: Main path: J1 -> F1 10 A -> VBAT -> J3 to the Pololu Big Pushbutton Power Switch -> back on J4 (VSW) -> F3 8 A -> J5 to the main board.

g.desc: Main path: J1 -> F1 10 A -> VBAT -> J3 to the Pololu Big Pushbutton Power Switch -> back on J4 (VSW) -> F3 8 A -> J5 to the main board.

g.text: Copper: 2 oz both sides; VBAT / VSW / BAT_IN are top pours >= 6 mm wide, GND is the bottom pour (IPC-2221 ext.: 3.5 mm at 2 oz for 10 A, 10 C rise).

g.desc: Copper: 2 oz both sides; VBAT / VSW / BAT_IN are top pours >= 6 mm wide, GND is the bottom pour (IPC-2221 ext.: 3.5 mm at 2 oz for 10 A, 10 C rise).

g.text: Charging joins VBAT before the switch, so it works with the robot switched off.

g.desc: Charging joins VBAT before the switch, so it works with the robot switched off.

g.text: I2C: INA219 CHARGE MONITOR, TCA9534 GPIO, HEADER

g.desc: I2C: INA219 CHARGE MONITOR, TCA9534 GPIO, HEADER

g.text: U1 DRV5032AJ: BOP 9.5 mT max, BRP 3 mT min. N52 3/8 x 1/16 in disc

g.desc: U1 DRV5032AJ: BOP 9.5 mT max, BRP 3 mT min. N52 3/8 x 1/16 in disc

g.text: alive with the robot off. U3 runs from the main board 3V3 (J6, via F4).

g.desc: alive with the robot off. U3 runs from the main board 3V3 (J6, via F4).

g.text: Main board (not ours): LSM6DSL 0x6A; its 4.7k pull-ups serve the whole bus.

g.desc: Main board (not ours): LSM6DSL 0x6A; its 4.7k pull-ups serve the whole bus.

g.text: J6 pin order 3V3/GND/SDA/SCL matches main board J7. F4 0.1 A PTC on the incoming 3V3.

g.desc: J6 pin order 3V3/GND/SDA/SCL matches main board J7. F4 0.1 A PTC on the incoming 3V3.

g.text: R11/R12 stay DNP (if ever fitted, pull up to +3V3_WS, never to +3V3_AON, so the bus

g.desc: R11/R12 stay DNP (if ever fitted, pull up to +3V3_WS, never to +3V3_AON, so the bus

g.text: does not back-power the ESP32 when the robot is off).

g.desc: does not back-power the ESP32 when the robot is off).

g.text: U2 runs from VBAT all the time (2.5 uA Iq): U1 + U4 keep the interlock

g.desc: U2 runs from VBAT all the time (2.5 uA Iq): U1 + U4 keep the interlock

g.text: at 9 mm on axis gives ~20 mT (2x margin); release <= ~20 mm.

g.desc: at 9 mm on axis gives ~20 mT (2x margin); release <= ~20 mm.
